title: Automated quant impact attribution and threshold recommender
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We routinely roll quantized model variants (int8/int4, AWQ/GPTQ) and config changes that can produce subtle quality regressions on specific cohorts. Current dashboards surface deltas but do not attribute regressions to the exact config/model change, nor do they recommend safe per-route thresholds for bitwidth or automatic rollback.

Goal: Build an automated pipeline that attributes observed evaluation delta to a specific quant/config change and proposes conservative, cohort-aware threshold recommendations for model gating and automated rollbacks. The system should support AWQ and GPTQ families, multiple bitwidths (int8, int4, hybrid), and integrate into the Console rollout flow and Optimize recommendations.

Scope/Deliverables: 1) Attribution harness that runs paired A/B-style evals per-commit and per-profile and produces causal attribution scores by cohort; 2) Bayesian threshold recommender that ingests per-cohort metric distributions and outputs per-route bitwidth bands and rollback thresholds (confidence intervals); 3) Integration hooks for Console: a summary tile with attribution heatmap and a one-click 'apply recommended thresholds' workflow; 4) Regression guard that can be used by rollouts to trigger automatic fallback to baseline variants when thresholds are exceeded.

Non-goals: Full retraining or model modification. This ticket focuses on evaluation, attribution, and recommendations, not on automated re-quantization pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Attribution harness can run a batch of 5k eval samples across 6 cohorts and produce a ranked list of likely contributing config changes for a given regression
Recommender produces per-route threshold bands (lower/upper) with 90% credible intervals and an expected token-cost delta estimate
Console integration surfaces the attribution heatmap and exposes an 'apply thresholds' button that creates a rollout change with recommended gating config
Automated rollback: if live traffic exhibits metric deterioration beyond recommended thresholds for 10 minutes, the system triggers a documented fallback and creates an incident ticket
test_plan: Unit tests for attribution stats (bootstrap resampling and Bayesian delta estimation)
Synthetic regressions: inject controlled noise into weights to validate attribution ranking correctness
E2E staging run: deploy recommended thresholds to a canary route with 5% traffic and validate rollback triggers on a simulated regression
Load test: ensure eval harness completes a full AWQ vs GPTQ comparison for a medium model (<20B params) within 4 hours on CI runners
